experiences.description: Architecting and building backend services using Java and Spring Boot. Designing RESTful APIs, optimizing PostgreSQL queries, and maintaining service reliability in production.
experiences.tags: Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, REST APIs

experiences.description: Intensive full-stack Java development training. Covered advanced Java concepts, Spring Framework, Hibernate/JPA, and SQL. Built multiple projects from scratch under mentorship.
experiences.tags: Java, Spring Framework, Hibernate / JPA, SQL

experiences.description: Contributed to R&D initiatives exploring new technology solutions. Implemented proof-of-concept features, conducted feasibility studies, and collaborated on product innovation.

projects.challenge: Free-tier cold starts on Render cause multi-second spin-up delays. Solved with skeleton loaders and background wake-up pings so perceived load feels near-instant to visitors.
projects.description: My personal developer portfolio built with a Spring Boot backend and a responsive, premium single-page application frontend.
projects.highlight: A Spring Boot REST API + PostgreSQL backend, Flyway-managed schema, admin panel for content management, Docker containerised and deployed on Render with zero-downtime rolling restarts.
projects.problem: My personal developer portfolio built with a Spring Boot backend served as a REST API and a responsive, premium single-page application frontend — demonstrating real backend architecture rather than a static file.
projects.technologies: Java, Spring Boot, REST API, HTML/CSS/JS
projects.title: Developer Portfolio

projects.challenge: Keeping search response time fast despite querying across multiple data dimensions (category, location, keyword) simultaneously without index bloat.
projects.description: A full-stack restaurant discovery platform featuring smart search, geolocation sorting, and a modern aesthetic.
projects.highlight: Full-stack food discovery platform with smart search, category filters, geolocation-based sorting, and a modern responsive UI — all backed by a Spring Boot REST API and PostgreSQL.
projects.problem: Discovering local food options is fragmented across multiple apps and hard to filter meaningfully. Users need a single, fast interface with geolocation awareness.
projects.technologies: Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, JS, Docker
projects.title: FoodFinder

projects.challenge: Handling OMDB API rate limits gracefully and implementing JWT authentication in a stateless Spring Boot setup without session storage.
projects.description: A Spring Boot and vanilla JavaScript application for searching OMDB movies and saving favorites with caching and JWT auth.
projects.highlight: Movie discovery UI with real-time search, detail views, favourites saved per user session with JWT auth, and client-side caching to avoid redundant API calls.
projects.problem: No clean, focused interface to search and explore movie data from the OMDB catalog. Existing tools are cluttered or require accounts.
projects.technologies: Java, Spring Boot, Supabase, Vanilla JS
projects.title: OMDB Movie Explorer

projects.challenge: Designing the RBAC model cleanly so data-scope enforcement happens at the service layer, not scattered across controllers — ensuring no role can query another role's data.
projects.description: Backend system with role-based access and REST APIs.
projects.highlight: Multi-role web application with separate scoped dashboards — Admin sees institution-wide data, Faculty manages only their assigned classes, Students track their own attendance records.
projects.problem: Manual attendance tracking is error-prone and gives zero real-time visibility to faculty or administrators. Spreadsheets break down at scale.
projects.title: Student Attendance Management System

projects.challenge: Decoupling the frame-processing thread from the motor-control thread to eliminate actuation lag caused by blocking I/O — solved with a producer-consumer queue pattern.
projects.description: ML-based face tracking system for live video stabilization.
projects.highlight: Computer vision pipeline using OpenCV and a CNN that detects faces per frame and drives servo motors via serial commands to keep the subject centred automatically.
projects.problem: Static cameras lose subjects in dynamic environments. Needed hardware that physically follows a face in real time without manual camera control.
projects.title: Realtime Face Tracking Gimbal

projects.challenge: Managing audio playback state cleanly without a framework. Implemented a minimal state machine for reliable play/pause/next/prev transitions across edge cases.
projects.description: A dynamic web application built for playing, organizing, and managing music collections directly in the browser.
projects.highlight: Browser-based music webapp with full playback controls, queue management, track metadata display, and a clean focused interface — zero external dependencies.
projects.problem: Wanted a lightweight, dependency-free web music player without streaming platform constraints or heavy framework overhead.
projects.title: Music Webapp

projects.challenge: Randomising question and answer order per session while tracking per-question progress reliably in session storage across page interactions without state corruption.
projects.description: An interactive, browser-based quiz application that tracks scores and provides immediate feedback.
projects.highlight: Dynamic quiz application with configurable question sets, per-question countdown timer, randomised answer order, and a detailed results breakdown — fully client-side.
projects.problem: Self-assessment quizzes need instant feedback and a detailed score breakdown to be useful for learning — most implementations are too simple or require a backend.
projects.title: Quiz Web App

principles.description: I map the data model and API contract before writing the first line. Rushing to code means more time debugging the wrong solution.
principles.title: Design before code

principles.description: I check execution plans, avoid N+1 problems, and add indexes deliberately — not as an afterthought when production slows down.
principles.title: Query performance is not optional

principles.description: Consumers shouldn't need to know how data is stored or processed. The API surface matters more than what's behind it.
principles.title: APIs are contracts, not implementation details

principles.description: Clever code is a liability. I name things clearly, keep methods small, and leave the codebase in a state I'd want to find it six months later.
principles.title: Readable code ages better
